Present Perfect / Past Perfect — has/have/had + 3-я форма
Page 1 / 0

Perfect: вспомогательный глагол

Present Perfect = has/have + 3-я форма (has introduced, has come). Past Perfect = had + 3-я форма (had had, had finished). Вспомогательный глагол не пропускается, даже если смысл и так понятен из контекста. Заполни пропуски. В заданиях 9–10 — исправь готовую фразу.

1. The government (introduce) a new education law this year.

2. She (not / finish) her homework yet.

3. They (already / come) to an agreement about the project.

4. I (never / be) to Durham University, but I'd love to go.

5. By the time we arrived, the lecture (already / start).

6. She (never / have) such a difficult exam before that day.

7. He told me he (finish) the project before the deadline.

8. I (just / receive) the results of my test.

9. Исправь: “She is coming to this conclusion many times before.” — (вместо is coming)

10. Исправь: “By the age of ten, he had a very hard childhood already behind him.” — had a very hard childhood.
